data_fields.name: annihilation_chance
data_fields.donor_constant: blockAnnihilationChance, float per damage source, no default read

data_fields.name: impulse_power
data_fields.donor_constant: impulsePower, float per damage source; 0 when no component

data_fields.name: hardness
data_fields.donor_constant: 3 (0 = indestructible); not consumed in this box

best_idea: Run a node break as three steps in a fixed order: a before-break veto that can keep the node, then a drop roll with a per-source annihilation chance computed before the node is removed, then a direct grant to the breaker's bag when the node allows it, else a world drop with a kick.
decision_why: The veto, drop roll and direct-pickup-first order fit a server-verified gathering node as zone data, with one ledger write per grant; the world-drop kick is cosmetic only, and the damage side (hardness, tool multipliers) is not in this box so it is not adopted.
acceptance: A server test: over 10,000 seeded breaks of a node with annihilation chance 0.25, about 75 percent produce an item; a vetoed break leaves the node and grants nothing; a direct-pickup node writes one ledger grant per item and a full bag falls back to a world drop; the player sees the item in the bag or on the ground with a short kick.
